videos.title: Claude's Artifacts now even more powerful
summary: Futurepedia covers Anthropic's expansion of Claude's Artifacts feature, which now supports five new output formats: Documents, Slides, Design, Dashboard, and Motion.

The video explains each format: Docs functions like an editable, chat-driven Google Docs; Slides lets users create and present decks directly from Claude or export them as PowerPoint files; and Design is described as a powerful tool for prototyping social posts, websites, apps, or other visual work.

Motion is highlighted as building animations and motion graphics purely through code rather than an AI video generator, and the video notes that Dashboard and Motion are still in beta and may not be visible to all users yet, consistent with Futurepedia's role tracking new Claude feature rollouts.
